title: Prime-Encoding Masking for Block-Cipher Side-Channel Security
summary: For software and hardware block-cipher implementations, it remains open whether masking with prime encodings improves side-channel security.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether masking with prime encodings improves the side-channel security of block-cipher implementations in software and hardware.

scope.domain: This problem concerns side-channel security for block-cipher implementations masked with prime encodings on software and hardware platforms.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether prime-encoding masking improves the side-channel security of block-cipher implementations in software and hardware.

citations.label: Effective and Efficient Masking with Low Noise using Small-Mersenne-Prime Ciphers

progress.summary: The source explicitly poses the potential side-channel-security benefit of prime-encoding masking as an open question for both software and hardware implementations.
